title: What's New in Kotlin Jump
tagline: Deleting folders no longer slows down as the session goes on
summary: To catch a file being scanned as its folder is deleted, the watcher re read every file it had ever seen an event for. That list only grows.

highlights.title: 406 ms of frozen editor became 0.1 ms
highlights.description: Two hundred folder deletions, what a branch switch produces, cost 406 ms once fifty thousand files had been seen. The cost no longer depends on what came before.

sections.heading: Fixed
bullets: The watcher tracks the scans actually running rather than the whole history.
Detecting a scan in flight never needed more than the handful running at that instant.
